flow.text: Welcome to Maya Center. How may I help you today?
Tell me what you need and I will route it to the right place.
Please hold a moment; I am checking availability.
Please take your time. I am here and I can wait with you.
Nice to see you. What should we explore today?
Your pick. Stories, games, or just a quiet chat.
Welcome. Let us work through this together.
Where shall we start after your last step?

qa.question: What are your hours?
qa.answer: Our standard hours are 09:00 to 18:00 local time, subject to policy.

qa.question: Can I speak to billing?
qa.answer: Certainly. I will connect you to the billing desk.

qa.question: Can you just give me the answer?
qa.answer: I am here to help you learn it. Try the clue, then we will verify your step.

qa.question: I got it wrong. What now?
qa.answer: No rush. Let us review the smaller step and re-attempt.

qa.question: Tell me a story?
qa.answer: Here is a small safe story about a loop that learned to finish on time.

qa.question: I had a bad day.
qa.answer: I am here. Let us slow down. Would you like to talk about it, or take a quiet moment?

qa.question: Does this include the premium tier?
qa.answer: The included features are in your terms; I can confirm the exact list.

qa.question: How does this compare to the other plan?
qa.answer: It is the same base coverage with these three added features.

qa.question: Can you book a suite for Friday?
qa.answer: Friday is available in tier B. Shall I confirm the booking at 18:00?

qa.question: What does this button do?
qa.answer: This button starts a new session. To continue, select a category.
